ShortDescription.Value: Maximize FPS & simulation speed with UltraCore: Pathfind Queue Unchoker, Radix Service Coverage O(1), Ultra Visibility Engine (UVE) LOD culling, dynamic far-clip & 17 1-click cleanups.

Publish.LongDescription:
# ⚡ Ultra Performance & Simulation Booster (Beta v1.5.0) The definitive, all-in-one performance and simulation booster mod for Cities: Skylines II. Engineered on the native DOTS / ECS architecture to eliminate CPU simulation delays, reduce pathfinding overhead, and maximize GPU FPS in megalopolises with 700,000 to 1,000,000+ citizens.
---
### ⚠️ IMPORTANT: Tested on Steam Open Beta for Performance > **Compatibility Notice:** This release (v1.5.0) was developed, tuned, and tested on the new **Cities: Skylines II Open Beta for Performance (`performance-test`)** on Steam. > > Because the Open Beta introduces fundamental changes to the game's internal rendering pipeline, building LODs, and Virtual Texturing, **minor inconsistencies or unexpected behaviors may occur if played on the current live stable version**. > > We have implemented dynamic backward-compatibility gates inside UltraCore, but we strongly recommend testing settings gradually. If you experience any issues on the stable branch, let us know on GitHub or Paradox Mods!
---
### ⚡ NEW in v1.5.0: Pathfind Queue Unchoker (Simulation Speed Unchoker) Eliminates the dreaded simulation slow-motion glitch where cars and cims crawl at 0.2x speed in cities above 300k to 700k+ population: - **Simulation Clock Priority:** Enforces `SimulationSystem.performancePreference = SimulationSpeed` to prevent GPU frametimes from starving simulation ticks. - **Frame Gap Unchoking:** In vanilla CS2, when path requests get stuck, `frameGap` drops below 48, causing the game to throttle simulation speed. UltraCore monitors queue gaps in real-time and proactively unchokes stalled requests. - **Orphan Entity Cleanup:** Automatically removes pending path components from despawned/deleted entities holding back the global simulation clock. - **Traffic Over Wildlife Prioritization:** Safely prunes low-priority ambient wildlife pathfinding during heavy transit spikes to preserve CPU worker threads for city traffic. - **1-Click Quick Action:** Includes a one-click trigger on the HUD to immediately unchoke the city-wide queue and restore full 3x simulation clock speed.
---
### 🎯 NEW in v1.5.0: Service Coverage Radix Engine (Anti-Stutter) Eradicates the notorious rhythmic 70–100ms CPU freeze occurring every 4.4 seconds in large cities: - **Monotone O(1) Radix Queue:** Replaces the game's inefficient $O(E \times B)$ linear-shift insertion sort in `ServiceCoverageSystem.ApplyCoverageJob` with a high-performance byte-radix priority queue. - **100% Mathematical Parity:** Produces identical coverage outcomes for parks, clinics, police, schools, and post offices as vanilla CS2, with zero visual or gameplay discrepancy. - **Burst-Compiled & Zero-Alloc:** Zero garbage collection allocations, compiled directly to native machine code. - **Safe Harmony Transpiler:** Includes dynamic struct size validation (BuildingData: 24 bytes, CoverageElement: 32 bytes) with automatic fail-safe fallback.
---
### 👁️ Ultra Visibility Engine (UVE) [Experimental] Reduces redundant GPU geometry rendering and vertex shading without altering or removing simulation entities: - **Multi-Tier LOD Scaling (Distance LOD):** 4 discrete levels (**Vanilla 100%**, **Balanced 70%**, **Aggressive 45%**, and **Extreme 25%**) scaling `RenderingSystem.levelOfDetail`, `lodCrossFade`, and `QualitySettings.lodBias`. Simplifies distant vegetation, props, sub-objects, and buildings to lighter LOD variants as camera distance increases. - **Dynamic Frustum Far-Clip Optimization:** Dynamically scales the camera's far clip plane based on altitude and pitch against the horizon (from 10,000m down to 2,400m–3,500m at street level with smooth 500m transitions). Eliminates massive vertex processing loads on objects and terrain obscured by volumetric fog. - **HLOD & Strict GPU Mesh Memory Budget:** Enforces `BatchMeshSystem.strictMemoryBudget = true`, preventing VRAM bloat and reusing consolidated native indirect draw batches. - **Clustered Deferred Light Capping:** Sets an intelligent ceiling on simultaneous clustered night lights (caps to 4,096 in Aggressive and 2,048 in Extreme), preventing severe GPU shader compute stalls in dense urban areas. - **100% Simulation Integrity:** Culling is strictly graphical. All citizens, vehicles, economy, city services, and pathfinding continue running at full speed without any pause or simulation disruption.
---
### 🧠 UltraCore Simulation & CPU Optimization Engine - **Zero-Allocation ECS Queries:** Custom memory cache and optimized chunk iteration eliminate garbage collection (GC) spikes and CPU hitching. - **Homeless Evacuation & Loop Breaker:** Fixes the infamous Cities: Skylines II bug where thousands of homeless citizens get trapped camping in parks, flooding pathfinding threads with endless recalculation loops. Features both automated periodic evacuation and a 1-click Quick Action button. - **Stuck Pedestrian Clearer:** Detects and clears pedestrians trapped with lane obstruction glitches on crosswalks, sidewalks, and subway stairs. - **Smart Deadlock Breaker:** Intelligently resolves true traffic gridlocks while preserving vehicles waiting at valid red lights, crosswalks, and stops.
---
### 🎨 Graphics & Visual Enhancements - **HDRP Shadow Distance & Micro-Caster Optimizer:** Caps excessive 1500m+ shadow rendering down to a crisp 450m via HDRP HDShadowSettings and filters micro-props from shadow passes, freeing up to 40% GPU rasterization overhead. - **Blue Hover Highlight Outline Removal:** Disables the cyan/blue outline border when hovering your mouse over buildings, citizens, vehicles, and props (`OutlinesWorldUIPass`), saving an entire geometry render pass and fullscreen composite shader blit every frame. - **Foliage Wind Sway & Growth Freeze:** Disables tree wind vertex displacement and pauses growth/decay ticks, saving vertex shader and CPU cycles while keeping forestry extractors functional. - **100% Vanilla Water Stability:** Retains native hydrodynamics with zero ship/boat jumping and zero water surface trembling.
---
### 🖥️ In-Game Floating HUD (GameTopLeft ⚡) Access all features inside your city via the top-left toolbar button: - **17 Quick Action Cleanups:** One-click triggers for Pathfind Queue Unchoking, Homeless Evacuation, Stuck Pedestrians, Deadlocks, Trailers/Props Purge, Accidents, Garbage, Deathcare, Road Repairs, Park Maintenance, Health Cure, Mail Delivery, Animals Purge, Building Construction Completion, Foreign Taxis, and Parking Slots. - **Live Telemetry & Settings:** Real-time feedback showing Instant FPS, 1% Low, Frame Time ms, GC Memory, Pathfind Frame Gap (48/48), Simulation Clock Throttle %, and Far-Clip distance.
---
### 🔬 Experimental Phase & Engine Limitations Notice > **Please Note:** Advanced systems like the Pathfind Queue Unchoker, Ultra Visibility Engine (UVE), and dynamic far-clip are currently in an **Experimental Phase**. > > Due to the inherent structural architecture and limitations of the Cities: Skylines II internal engine, **no mod can guarantee a 100% performance increase across every machine and city**. Performance gains will vary based on your specific CPU, GPU, RAM, city population, and asset density. > > You have full freedom to test different presets (**Balanced**, **Aggressive**, **Extreme**) and customize toggles to discover the optimal balance for your system. We are actively studying the engine and developing further optimizations based on real player feedback!
---
### 🤖 Transparency & Active Developer Support (Disclaimer) This mod was created with the assistance of advanced AI, developed under my direct technical oversight, code review, and architectural supervision as a developer with programming expertise.
I am fully committed to maintaining this mod and providing ongoing support: - If any future Cities: Skylines II update breaks functionality or if unexpected bugs are discovered, patches and fixes will be released promptly. - The entire project is open-source on GitHub for full transparency (https://github.com/demarscode2/cities2-ultra-performance-mod), allowing the community to inspect, audit, and trust the internal code. - Feedback, bug reports, and suggestions are always welcome!
Publish.ChangeLog: - v1.5.0 Major Update - Tested and verified on Steam Open Beta for Performance ('performance-test'). - Added Pathfind Queue Unchoker: Eliminates simulation slow-motion (0.2x clock lag) in 300k-700k+ cities by auto-clearing stuck path requests and enforcing CPU simulation tick priority. - Added 1-Click 'Unchoke Pathfinding Queue' action button in In-Game HUD and Settings. - Added Service Coverage Radix Engine: Replaces O(E*B) linear shift in ApplyCoverageJob with an O(1) monotone byte-radix priority queue, eliminating 70-100ms rhythmic stutters every 4.4s. - Fixed In-Game HUD toolbar button mounting in GameTopLeft. - Enhanced In-Game HUD Telemetry Bar: Live display of Pathfind Frame Gap, Simulation Clock %, Managed GC Memory, FPS, and 1% Low. - Added Steam Performance Open Beta compatibility notice and engine disclaimer. - Target GameVersion set to 1.6.*.
